dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: Ughhhh... This is my first time trying the delicacies of the Collective of Plenty, and this is clearly a delicious meal, but why does it have to be like this...

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! Here's the deal — my name's Erdalf and I'm an adventurer from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: I heard the food at the Collective of Plenty was beyond compare, and even better, I heard it was healthy. So, I came here to order their signature meal for one...

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: But just look at the size of this portion! It's excessive!

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: How can this possibly be a meal for one!? Is tackling this mountain of food what the locals consider an "adventure"?

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: Bon appetit... I mean, goodbye! May your travels — and mine — be blessed by appropriate portion sizes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Couldn't you have just asked for the rest to-go?

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: Well, that's what I thought at first, but it seemed a little rude. After all, the owner was so welcoming. And what was it they said again... Oh, right. "Eat every last bite and you'll become as strong as a Tatankasaurus!"

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: Still, I'm sure they'll be happy to box it up for me if I genuinely can't finish. I mean, it wouldn't do to let such good food go to waste...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why didn't you just tell them you couldn't finish it all?

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: Well, I thought of that too, but they seem to view food as a symbol of friendship. If I leave too much on my plate, I'm worried they might think I don't appreciate their kindness...

dialogues.speaker: Erdalf
dialogues.text: *sigh* Never mind. Next time, I'll just have to ask for a kid's serving...
